name: Houndarr
description: Scheduled backlog searches for Radarr, Sonarr, Lidarr, Readarr and Whisparr. Works through missing and cutoff-unmet items in small rate-limited batches with per-item cooldowns and hourly caps, to avoid overloading indexers. ([Source Code](https://github.com/av1155/houndarr)) `AGPL-3.0` `Python/Docker`
